/*&#13;
 * Function determines the reset password activity used in the workflow based upon the process's credential&#13;
 * store. Function also populates scratch pad variables used throughout the workflow.&#13;
 * @return void&#13;
 */&#13;
function run() {&#13;
	var LOGID = '[' + context.name + ' Workflow : ' + activity.name + ' Activity] --&gt; ';&#13;
	// Retrieve request info:&#13;
	var grRequest = new GlideRecord('pwd_reset_request');&#13;
	if (!grRequest.get(workflow.inputs.u_request_id)) {&#13;
		return logError(LOGID + "The request id " + workflow.inputs.u_request_id + " has no process associated with it.");&#13;
	}&#13;
	workflow.scratchpad.user_sysid = grRequest.user;&#13;
	workflow.scratchpad.process_id = grRequest.process;&#13;
	&#13;
	// Retrieve user info:&#13;
	var grSysUser = new GlideRecord("sys_user");&#13;
	if (!grSysUser.get(workflow.scratchpad.user_sysid)) {&#13;
		return logError(LOGID + "The user sysid " + workflow.scratchpad.user_sysid + " is not valid.");&#13;
	}&#13;
	&#13;
	workflow.scratchpad.userName = grSysUser.user_name;&#13;
	&#13;
	workflow.info(LOGID + 'inputs: [RequestId=' + workflow.inputs.u_request_id + '] [UserName=' + workflow.scratchpad.userName + '] processSysId=' + workflow.scratchpad.process_id + ']');&#13;
	&#13;
	// Retrieve cred-store mapped to process:&#13;
	var gr = new GlideRecord("pwd_map_proc_to_cred_store");&#13;
	gr.addQuery("process", workflow.scratchpad.process_id);&#13;
	gr.query();&#13;
	if (gr.getRowCount() != 1) {&#13;
		return logError(LOGID + 'There are ' + gr.getRowCount() + ' credential stores defined for process ' + workflow.scratchpad.process_id + '. There should only be one.');&#13;
	}&#13;
	gr.next(); // No need to check for error, because we already validated number of rows earlier&#13;
	workflow.scratchpad.cred_store_id = gr.cred_store;&#13;
	&#13;
	// Retrieve cred-store info:&#13;
	var grCredStore = GlideRecord('pwd_cred_store');&#13;
	if (!grCredStore.get(workflow.scratchpad.cred_store_id)) {&#13;
		return logError(LOGID + "Cannot find credential store: " + workflow.scratchpad.cred_store_id);&#13;
	}&#13;
	workflow.scratchpad.sub_wf = grCredStore.type.pwd_change_wf.name;&#13;
	var wf = new Workflow();&#13;
	if (wf.getWorkflowFromName(workflow.scratchpad.sub_wf) == null) {&#13;
		return logError(LOGID + "Sub workflow " + workflow.scratchpad.sub_wf + " does not exist.");&#13;
	}&#13;
	&#13;
	// check if an account lookup script is provided&#13;
	if (!grCredStore.account_lookup.nil()) {&#13;
		var scriptName = grCredStore.account_lookup.name;&#13;
		// call the specified extension&#13;
		var params = new SNC.PwdExtensionScriptParameter();&#13;
		params.userId = workflow.scratchpad.user_sysid;&#13;
		&#13;
		try {&#13;
			var userLookupExtension = new SNC.PwdExtensionScript(grCredStore.account_lookup.sys_id);&#13;
			workflow.scratchpad.accountName = userLookupExtension.process(params);&#13;
		} catch (err) {&#13;
			return logError(LOGID + err.message);&#13;
		}&#13;
	} else {&#13;
		workflow.scratchpad.accountName = workflow.scratchpad.userName;&#13;
	}&#13;
	&#13;
	activity.result = 'success';&#13;
	&#13;
	// Setup params for email notificaiton&#13;
	// Retrieve process name&#13;
	var grProc = new GlideRecord("pwd_process");&#13;
	if (!grProc.get(workflow.scratchpad.process_id)) {&#13;
		logError(LOGID + "The process id " + workflow.scratchpad.process_id + "  is not valid.");&#13;
	}&#13;
	// If process name is empty, continue with empty name (but dont fail WF)&#13;
	workflow.scratchpad.processName = grProc.name;&#13;
	workflow.scratchpad.notification_subject = "Password Change Notification for " + workflow.scratchpad.processName;&#13;
	workflow.scratchpad.notification_message = "Hi " + workflow.scratchpad.userName + ",\n\n" +&#13;
	"Your password has been changed successfully for " + workflow.scratchpad.processName + ".\n\n" +&#13;
	"If you have not recently changed your password and believe someone may have accessed your account, please contact IT.\n\n" +&#13;
	"Thank you";&#13;
}&#13;
&#13;
/*&#13;
 * Helper function to handle error exit condition&#13;
 * @param msg : Defines the activity fault description and workflow error.&#13;
 * @return void&#13;
 */&#13;
function logError(msg) {&#13;
	activity.result = 'failure';&#13;
	activity.fault_description = msg;&#13;
	workflow.error(msg);&#13;
	return;&#13;
}</value>
